name: Rafael Drone Dome

atlas_legacy_record.note: Values below come from the live legacy atlas page captured on 2026-09-02 and were NOT independently verified in this upgrade pass. They are carried forward for continuity only and must not be cited as evidence.

what_it_is: Rafael's DRONE DOME is a modular counter-UAS system combining radar, EO/IR and RF sensors with soft-kill jamming and (in later configurations) hard-kill laser options, designed for air-base, urban and critical-infrastructure defence. It has been certified and fielded by Western air forces.
india_angle: Drone Dome-class systems matter to India primarily as the reference architecture its own C-UAS programmes emulate; no Indian Drone Dome sale is publicly confirmed. Rafael's India presence runs through joint ventures (e.g. with Kalyani group) that could carry such systems locally.
intelligence_assessment: The system's record is verifiable through Rafael and Western trade press. For the India file, watch Rafael-Kalyani JV product announcements and Indian air-base C-UAS tenders rather than assumption of deployment.

faq.q: Is Drone Dome deployed in India?
faq.a: No Indian Drone Dome deployment is publicly confirmed; Rafael's India engagements run through joint ventures and tender participation.
